headline: New extension of the pump subsidy under consideration – 'Jump' above two euros for unleaded and diesel
summary: The Greek government is considering a new extension of its 10-cent-per-litre diesel pump subsidy. The move follows a rally in international oil prices that pushed unleaded and diesel above two euros.
why: Fuel subsidies affect consumer prices and government spending. Greek pump prices track international crude and refined product markets.
